status: Ten original proposed cases; all Not executed

tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need guided device diagnosis that preserves unsynced notes and distinguishes a connected pen from received matter evidence.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use a synthetic device adapter with low battery, timed discovery, persistent green light, another-app pairing and internet loss. Show the appropriate next check; persistent green stops the flow and produces a support handoff with limited diagnostic data. Do not repeatedly forget/re-pair or erase local notes as a default repair. A connected state never marks a note ingested. On reconnect/restart replay the same stroke batch twice: retain one attributable note with device/matter/owner identity and a separate server acknowledgement. Refuse cross-user device takeover without an explicit transfer path; unknown firmware/device behavior remains unverified.

tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need to inspect a rewritten prompt before submitting it and retain the exact original for audit.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Enhance a synthetic composer containing my clients, November14,2026 and a quoted instruction. Show original/rewrite and preserve I/me/my, exact quotation and four-digit years. Immediate Undo restores the original byte content. Test edit, send and new-message boundaries against the documented undo window; archive the original even when one-click Undo is unavailable. A stale enhancement response cannot overwrite a later edit or changed matter scope. Enhancement alone never submits a prompt, invents a requested action or grants permission for a case change.

tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need visible mode and matter scope so a default change or new chat cannot silently broaden access or pretend it retained my instructions.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Set default Project Chat with no project: show the effective Work fallback before submission. Select matterA and verify the effective mode/capabilities; an explicit override is distinct from the stored default. After starting a chat switch mode: create a separate chat, label that context was not transferred, and preserve the old history. In the proposed application any optional context-copy is an explicit reviewed operation and must recheck matter permissions. Deny advanced-tool requests in a restricted mode without silently running them. Maintain shared canonical matter data while isolating conversational context; neither implies unrestricted cross-matter access.

tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need counts and totals tied to a reproducible matter population with drill-down evidence.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Create synthetic activePI matters at both date boundaries, one archived record, one denied matter and three billing rows on a single matter. Compare count of cases, count of billing rows, per-case sums and full record list. Publish the selected date field, timezone, status/type values, missing-value treatment, population IDs and access-filter version. Joining billing rows must not multiply case counts. A request about cases not going well must expose an unresolved predicate rather than invent a success metric. Recompute after permission/schema changes; unknown or truncated results cannot be labeled exhaustive. SQL shown in vendor guidance is not evidence of executed query correctness.

tests.title: Reconcile effects that completed before a stop
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need each completed effect identified even after the run reports stopped.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Queue three synthetic note creations. Stop after the first commit, then simulate a delayed second acknowledgement. Reconcile every action against stable server IDs and show committed, not-started and uncertain states separately. Retry only the reviewed remainder with idempotency keys; do not erase the first note or imply rollback. An Open link is independently permission-checked and must identify the actual object.

tests.title: Keep action receipts separate from document evidence
tests.developer_story_extension: As the reviewer, I need a document citation to identify source content and an action receipt to identify an actual change.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use two similarly named source files and a note-creation action. Document citation must resolve to exact version/locator and supporting text; action citation must resolve to committed target ID and actor/job. Delete or revoke the target and preserve a truthful inaccessible/stale state. A model-generated Done card cannot substitute for server verification.

tests.title: Separate accepted attachments, usable text and authorized filing
tests.developer_story_extension: As staff, I need a per-file processing ledger before uploaded material enters a matter or supports an answer.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use synthetic allowed/unsupported extensions, spoofed MIME, password-protected and image-only files, corrupt bytes and individual-size boundaries. Use sparse fixtures for large limits, not actual client files. Track accepted, parsed, text-extracted, analyzed and filed independently. Permission changes invalidate proposed folder/matter destinations. A5GB advertised ceiling does not promise processing speed or usable image interpretation; do not silently omit failed files.

tests.title: Reconcile scheduled-prompt labels with real future jobs
tests.developer_story_extension: As the user, I need next execution and failure status, not merely a human-readable daily label.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Test the documented ten-own-prompts boundary and per-user ownership; tenant quota/plan limits remain configurable until verified. A synthetic daily8AM prompt with no next-run record must show unscheduled/error, not active. Validate timezone and daylight-saving transitions and record actual job IDs/results. This audit neither creates nor changes any real scheduled task.

tests.title: Separate admin enablement, personal connection and firm skill access
tests.developer_story_extension: As the administrator, I need firm installation and individual authentication represented as different entitlement states.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Create synthetic admin/member roles. Admin enables a connector but a member without personal authentication cannot use it. Revoke the account role or provider session after configuration: recheck at execution. An installed firm plugin exposes permitted skill invocation without granting account-admin workflow editing. Deny forged admin requests server-side; preserve skill version, provider identity and limited audit evidence.

tests.title: Preserve document identity across editor output destinations
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need copy, PDF, DOCX download and matter attachment to have separate outcome evidence.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Create a synthetic draft with protected attorney wording. Compare clipboard text, printed/PDF output, DOCX bytes and the target matter attachment after approval; hash and version each artifact separately. A successful download cannot mark a matter attachment or client copy sent. Require correct matter access and a verified saved object before recording filing complete; preserve failed-save draft content.

limits: Fixture consistency only; no vendor/user app, hardware, payment, external message or actual scheduler operation.
